fields.review_notes: AC1 MET: 16/16 .agents/agents/*.agent.md carry model: (git grep confirms). AC3 MET: explore/research/commit -> GPT-5 mini, confirmed cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 on every priced axis (input 0.25 vs 3.0, output 2.0 vs 15.0, cache_read 0.025 vs 0.3 per model_prices.json); all 4 declared values (Claude Opus 5, Claude Sonnet 5, GPT-5 mini, GPT-5.4 mini) exist verbatim as model_id entries, no name mismatch. AC2/AC4 documented-not-enforced judged ACCEPTABLE: runSubagent model dispatch is a VS Code host mechanism with no in-repo dispatcher code to instrument, matching the precedent cd19fed4 used for its own AC4 (tool_search unavailability, accepted as pass). AC5 correctly DEFERRED-pending-10d21210, not gating. Contract-location sound: ec3b13f1 lists model: as non-goal, instruction-file placement avoids scope creep. Follow-up opened: 94c61173 to empirically verify AC2/AC4 once 10d21210 lands. Recommended state: done. Reviewer did not transition state.
